ns2:section.sectionText: This course is initially restricted to students already in the Actuarial Science major, but the restriction will be removed during business hours on May 6, 2020 for students interested in transfer and others. Prospective transfers should review the information at go.illinois.edu/actsci, particularly the On-campus transfer information and the Undergraduate advising notes......Some seats are reserved for off-campus transfer students in majors requiring this course. Any remaining seats would be released on the Friday before fall classes begin.
